headlines.description: Tottenham's expensive summer rebuild was shaken to its foundations by rampant Brentford on an alarming opening day for Roberto De Zerbi's side.
headlines.shortLinkText: Tottenham thumped by Brentford in PL opener

headlines.description: Dominic Calvert-Lewin fired a late equaliser as Leeds fought back to salvage a 1-1 draw against Brentford in their opening home Premier League game of the season.
headlines.shortLinkText: Dominic Calvert-Lewin scores late equaliser to salvage a 1-1 draw with Brentford at Elland Road
